title: Node policy files
what: The node service's policy read from TOML at build time: node states and their tones, the SSH check's options and patience, the Windows sensor release, and the node name rule, in crates/policy.

title: Node store
what: The node service's SQLite store under the data root's node folder: the node list, the hubs, the hardware settings and the hardware history with its rollups, migrated by user_version, in crates/store.

title: Repository rules checks
what: The tests that hold the repository to its own rules: no directory named after its parent, only Cargo manifests at the root, dependencies only on the base libraries, and no personal names, hosts, paths or Korean in code.

title: Node service clients
what: The node service's clients: bmo-node-client in crates/client, every body of the boundary API as a type and a call for every route and the event stream, and the TypeScript client in packages/node-client generated from docs/openapi.json.
